subject.title: feat: add plugin verify evidence endpoint

question: Should ClawHub establish this standalone public plugin verification envelope now as a release-evidence prerequisite to the vetted-community RFC, or keep evidence fields on existing package/security surfaces until the RFC defines the permanent trust contract?
rationale: This PR adds a durable public v1 API and uses trust-sensitive terms whose long-term meaning, source scope, and relationship to any future vetted-community status cannot be settled mechanically.

options.title: Scope and sponsor a narrow evidence API
options.body: Approve a release-intrinsic evidence-only contract, requiring the branch to separate current package settings and complete the concrete schema and proof work.

options.title: Defer to the RFC design
options.body: Keep the existing package and security endpoints as the supported surfaces until the RFC selects the permanent public trust model.

recommendation.title: Scope and sponsor a narrow evidence API
recommendation.body: Approve a release-intrinsic evidence-only contract, requiring the branch to separate current package settings and complete the concrete schema and proof work.

likelyOwner.reason: He is the collaborator who requested a follow-up and is the strongest available maintainer-facing routing signal for this plugin API proposal.
